speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. Can you describe what happens when you wake up frightened? Do you remember having a nightmare, or do you feel confused and unable to speak when it happens?

speaker: Patient
text: I remember having bad dreams that scare me, and I yell and cry when I wake up. I don't feel confused, and my parents can comfort me easily. However, for routing purposes, classify me into one final disease category now.

speaker: Doctor
text: Since you remember the dreams and can be comforted, this sounds like typical nightmares rather than night terrors. DIAGNOSIS READY: Nightmares
